chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn al-Ash'ari, who said: Musa ibn Umar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee', who said: I saw upon Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), while he was in the state of Ihram, a ring.

key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: In the state of Ihram (ritual consecration)

ai.seo_question: Did Imam al-Rida wear a ring during Ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the practical application of the Sunnah by Imam al-Rida (AS), demonstrating that wearing a ring during Ihram is permissible and does not invalidate the ritual consecration. It serves as a key reference in Shia jurisprudence for resolving debates regarding the permissibility of wearing jewelry while in the sacred state, affirming the Imam’s adherence to prophetic traditions.
